## Testing Mode
GREEN

test-exempt: static assets only / non-executable instruction files (behavioral-testing-standard.md Rule 5, exemption criterion 3). The deliverable of this task is a structured CLAUDE_MD_SUGGESTED_CHANGE report — a prose artifact describing proposed changes; it has no executable behavior.

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- DD4: When this story is complete, any proposed CLAUDE.md changes are delivered as CLAUDE_MD_SUGGESTED_CHANGE reports surfaced to the user — not applied directly

## Implementation Notes

CLAUDE.md must never be edited directly by a sub-agent per CLAUDE.md governance rules (doc-router Gate 5). This task emits a structured CLAUDE_MD_SUGGESTED_CHANGE report describing what CLAUDE.md should say differently after the dso.workflow consolidation.

### Report Content

Scan CLAUDE.md for all references to `enforcement.strategy` and `merge.strategy`. For each, draft the proposed replacement text using `dso.workflow` as the canonical key. At minimum, the following references should be updated in the suggestion:

1. **Quick Reference table** — any row referencing `enforcement.strategy=ci` or `merge.strategy=pr` should be updated to "set `dso.workflow=ci-pr`" as the canonical instruction.

2. **Architecture section** — the Config keys bullet currently lists `merge.strategy`, `enforcement.strategy`, `worktree.isolation_enabled`, `attribution.enabled`. The suggestion should replace this with `dso.workflow` as the primary key, noting the four legacy keys as deprecated.

3. **Critical rules** — Rule 18 currently cites `enforcement.strategy=ci` to describe the CI exception to the review gate. The suggestion should reference `dso.workflow=ci-pr` as the mode that produces this behavior.

4. Any other prose in CLAUDE.md that instructs agents to "set merge.strategy or enforcement.strategy" should be updated to "set dso.workflow".

### Report Format

Emit the report as a structured block at the end of the task's completion output:

```
CLAUDE_MD_SUGGESTED_CHANGE:
Section: <section name in CLAUDE.md>
Current: <exact current text>
Proposed: <proposed replacement text>
Reason: <one-sentence rationale>
---
```

Repeat for each independent change. Do NOT apply the changes to CLAUDE.md — emit the report only.

### DOC_ROUTER_ATTESTATION
Gate fired: 5 (CLAUDE.md governance — report only, no direct edit)
Target: CLAUDE_MD_SUGGESTED_CHANGE report (surfaced to orchestrator/user)
CLAUDE.md edited directly: no — governance rule prohibits direct edits by sub-agents
Lines added to CLAUDE.md: 0

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: TEST_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.test_unit) && [ -n "$TEST_CMD" ] && $TEST_CMD || echo "no unit test cmd configured — skip"
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: LINT_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.lint) && [ -n "$LINT_CMD" ] && $LINT_CMD || echo "no lint cmd configured — skip"
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: FORMAT_CHECK_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.format_check) && [ -n "$FORMAT_CHECK_CMD" ] && $FORMAT_CHECK_CMD || echo "no format_check cmd configured — skip"
- [ ] Task completion output contains at least one CLAUDE_MD_SUGGESTED_CHANGE: block
  Verify: echo "Manual: confirm sub-agent completion report contains CLAUDE_MD_SUGGESTED_CHANGE: block"
- [ ] CLAUDE.md is NOT modified by this task
  Verify: git diff HEAD -- CLAUDE.md | wc -c | xargs -I{} test {} -eq 0
- [ ] Each CLAUDE_MD_SUGGESTED_CHANGE block contains Section, Current, Proposed, and Reason fields
  Verify: echo "Manual: confirm CLAUDE_MD_SUGGESTED_CHANGE blocks contain all four required fields"

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
data.title: Emit CLAUDE_MD_SUGGESTED_CHANGE report for CLAUDE.md impacts from dso.workflow consolidation
